columns.archeology_template|scanregistration|cre: Crew reference code, 'OP' plus four digits.
columns.archeology_template|scanregistration|arc: Archive reference code, 'PR' plus four digits.
columns.archeology_template|scanregistration|ref: Reference mark, small numeric string 1-2 digits.
columns.archeology_template|scanregistration|ctr: Control points count or ID, numeric string 1-3 digits.
columns.archeology_template|scanregistration|log: Logging method category: Feature-based, Target-based, or Hybrid.
columns.archeology_template|scanregistration|err: Error scale metric type: RMSE, Cloud-to-Cloud, or Cloud-to-Mesh.
Error value in millimeters, real number.
columns.archeology_template|personnel|crewregist: Crew identifier code, OP followed by 4 digits, padded to 50 characters.
columns.archeology_template|personnel|crewlabel: Crew member display name, first and last name.
columns.archeology_template|personnel|leadregist: Lead identifier code, SV followed by 4 digits, padded to 50 characters.
columns.archeology_template|personnel|leadlabel: Lead member display name, first and last name.
columns.archeology_template|projects|arcregistry: Unique registry identifier code in format PR####, present for every row.
columns.archeology_template|projects|vesseltag: Label consisting of the word 'Project' followed by a descriptor word.
columns.archeology_template|projects|fundflux: Categorical funding source value: Government, University, Private, or Grant.
columns.archeology_template|projects|authpin: Authorization PIN-like identifier code PMT####, padded with trailing spaces to 50 characters.
columns.archeology_template|projects|authhalt: Date value in YYYY-MM-DD format, ranging from 2025-02-20 to 2026-02-19.
columns.archeology_template|scanqc|qualregistry: Unique integer ID, observed range 1 to 999.
columns.archeology_template|scanqc|arcref: Archive reference code: PR plus four digits, six characters.
columns.archeology_template|scanqc|crewref: Crew reference code: OP plus four digits, stored in 50-char padded field.
columns.archeology_template|scanqc|accucheck: Accuracy check status: Completed, Pending, or Not Required.
columns.archeology_template|scanqc|ctrlstate: Control state status: Failed, Pending, or Passed.
columns.archeology_template|scanqc|valimeth: Validation method: Automated, Hybrid, or Visual.
columns.archeology_template|scanqc|valistate: Validation state: Pending, Approved, or Rejected.
columns.archeology_template|scanqc|archstat: Archive status: Pending, Verified, or Completed.
columns.archeology_template|scanqc|pubstat: Publication status: Submitted, Draft, or Published.
columns.archeology_template|scanqc|copystat: Copy status: Reserved, Restricted, or Open Access.
columns.archeology_template|scanqc|refmention: Reference mention code: Citation- followed by four digits.
columns.archeology_template|scanqc|remark: Free-text remark field; about half of rows are NULL.
columns.archeology_template|scanspatial|domainre: Registry ID integer, unique per row.
columns.archeology_template|scanspatial|arcref: Arc reference code, text PR plus four digits.
columns.archeology_template|scanspatial|crewref: Crew reference code, text OP plus four digits, padded to 50 chars.
columns.archeology_template|scanspatial|angletil: Tilt angle, numeric degrees, can be negative.
columns.archeology_template|scanenvironment|zone: Zone reference code, SC plus 4 digits.
columns.archeology_template|scanenvironment|equi: Equipment reference, SN plus 5 digits padded to 50 chars.
columns.archeology_template|scanfeatures|traitre: Unique integer ID for trait registry. Range 1-999, all values distinct.
columns.archeology_template|scanfeatures|zoneref: Zone reference code. Format SC plus four digits, always 6 characters.
columns.archeology_template|scanfeatures|equipre: Equipment reference code. Format SN plus five digits, padded with spaces to 50 chars.
columns.archeology_template|scanfeatures|traitex: Trait extraction method. Values: Automatic, Semi-automatic, Manual.
columns.archeology_template|scanfeatures|traitco: Numeric trait count. Range 10-999, 633 distinct values.
columns.archeology_template|scanfeatures|articou: Numeric artifact count. Range 0-99, 101 distinct values.
columns.archeology_template|scanfeatures|structk: Structure kind. Values: Foundation, Complex, Wall, Floor, Artifact.
columns.archeology_template|scanfeatures|matkind: Material kind. Values: Mixed, Metal, Stone, Ceramic, Organic.
columns.archeology_template|scanfeatures|huestud: Hue study status. Values: Completed, Not Required, Partial.
columns.archeology_template|scanfeatures|texture: Texture study status. Values: Completed, Not Required, Partial.
columns.archeology_template|scanfeatures|pattern: Pattern note status. Values: Completed, Not Required, Partial.
columns.archeology_template|scanmesh|zoneref: Zone reference code, six characters, two letters followed by four digits.
columns.archeology_template|scanmesh|equipref: Equipment reference code, padded to 50 characters.
columns.archeology_template|scanmesh|uvmapqual: UV map quality level: High, Medium, or Low.
columns.archeology_template|sites|zonelabel: Zone label; readable name for registered zone.
columns.archeology_template|sites|heightm: Height value in meters; decimal number.
columns.archeology_template|sites|depthc: Depth value in centimeters; decimal number.
columns.archeology_template|sites|guardhint: Guard type hint: Permanent or Temporary.
columns.archeology_template|scanprocessing|flowr: Integer identifier for a scan processing flow record.
columns.archeology_template|scanprocessing|equip: Equipment reference code for the source scanner or device.
columns.archeology_template|scanprocessing|zoner: Zone reference code in the scan processing area.
columns.archeology_template|scanprocessing|flows: Name of the software used in the processing flow.
columns.archeology_template|scanprocessing|procc: CPU utilization percentage for the processing run.
columns.archeology_template|scanprocessing|procg: GPU utilization percentage for the processing run.
columns.archeology_template|scanprocessing|stash: Storage location for the processed data.
columns.archeology_template|scanprocessing|safeb: Backup status of the processed data.
columns.archeology_template|scanprocessing|metab: Metadata standard used for the data.
columns.archeology_template|scanprocessing|coord: Coordinate reference frame for spatial data.
columns.archeology_template|scanprocessing|stati: Station link status for the processing record.
columns.archeology_template|scanprocessing|flows: Current stage in the processing workflow.
columns.archeology_template|scanprocessing|fmtve: Format version of the output file or data specification.
columns.archeology_template|scanconservation|cur: Numeric identifier for the current registry record.
columns.archeology_template|scanpointcloud|cloud: Unique registry identifier for point cloud.
